svg.title: Type 2 candidate using the two fibres of one duplex Ethernet link
svg.desc: The DAC derives a compliant reverse Ethernet line clock from its audio reference. The transport extracts that continuous physical-layer frequency before elasticity, cleans it and disciplines audio production. Normal reverse control frames remain intact.
